source.title: Larne Times, 8 January 1927, p. 2 ("Larne Urban Council election")
source.publisher: Larne Times (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: The paper: 'only Messrs. Kirkwood and Lord had been renominated... the other retiring members were deemed to be re-elected in the absence of other nominations'.

note: Annual election of five urban councillors, one for each ward, January 1927; no contest, the retiring members being re-elected (Larne Times, 8 January 1927, p. 2). Renominated at the close on Thursday 6 January 1927. Returned unopposed.
